card.name: Time words ending a 'now' phrase
card.fires_on: Time words such as today, time, now, day and date that close a phrase about a point in time, such as 'at the time', 'at this time', 'to date' or 'every day'. The strongest cases are in general web prose.

modes.label: Phrase-ending 'time'
modes.description: The word 'time' ends a phrase like 'at the time', 'at this time' or 'at one time'.
modes.example: the Persians controlled part of the nation at one<< time>>, Oman has long been an independent country

modes.label: Today, now, day or date
modes.description: Adverbs of the present or a period, such as today, now, every day or to date, close a clause.
modes.example: policy and technology decisions made<< today>> will matter.

card.writes: It lowers words about the recent past or the present, such as 近年 and recent, and raises words like onwards.
card.plain: It fires on the last word of phrases like 'at the time' or 'to date' that pin down a moment.
